title: Cohomological dimension of a one-dimensional affine scheme over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the cohomological dimension of a one-dimensional affine scheme of finite type over a field K by 1 + cd(K) (statement lines 19650-19655). The proof routes everything through the Leray spectral sequence of f : X -> Spec(K) (proof lines 19658-19664): its E_2 terms involve the higher direct images R^q f_*F, whose stalks are identified with the cohomology of the pullback of F to the geometric fibre X_Kbar (proof lines 19665-19667), and the cited vanishing theorem for affine curves kills the row q at least 2, leaving only columns p at most cd(K) and hence no cohomology beyond 1 + cd(K) (proof lines 19668-19669). The non-formal content is the reading of the spectral sequence's vanishing region as a dimension bound. The claim is H2: one spectral-sequence bookkeeping argument with the cited vanishing as its only input.
